name: reshape-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for ReShape 3D modeling and sculpting in Blender

tools.name: reshape_model
tools.description: Create or edit a 3D asset in Blender through iterative modeling passes (Blockout, Volumes, Surface)

brief.description: Description of the 3D model to create or modify

style.description: Target style (e.g. faceted-low-poly, cel-shading, realism, clay)

tools.name: reshape_compare_views
tools.description: Render matching camera views (front, profile, three-quarter) across iterations with locked camera and lighting

tools.name: reshape_validate_mesh
tools.description: Run automated topology audits (manifoldness, normals, triangle count, watertightness)

targetUse.description: Target downstream application for the 3D mesh

tools.name: reshape_list_skills
tools.description: List all 44 anatomy and 10 style skills available in ReShape

tools.name: reshape_inspect_anatomy
tools.description: Retrieve anatomy landmarks, review angles, and rejection criteria for a specific body region

region.description: Anatomical region (e.g. head, face, eyes, nose, hands, torso)
